summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park, with homes 12-25 m away on both sides.
reasons: Homes within about 25 m all round

best_section.where: West kerb of Wooley Street beside the treed strip, halfway up towards the top junction

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto a bushy strip and a flat block behind it; apartments across the road, dwellings about 20-25 m both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb; narrow street but a van fits in the parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street; occasional local traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked here, so a van is less conspicuous, though residents will see it.

flags: Mapped gate 210 m away has a way round; ignore
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tall trees on both sides, especially the east.
